board.name: Wisconsin Physician Assistant Affiliated Credentialing Board (attached to the Medical Examining Board; administered by DSPS)

licence.title: Physician Assistant (PA)
licence.renewalDeadline: March 1 of each even numbered year (Wis. Stat. 440.08(2)(a)59.). DSPS states the reporting period as March 1 of an even year through February 28 of the next even year (its example: March 1, 2026 to February 28, 2028).

ce.categoryRules: At least 30 hours Category 1 as defined by NCCPA, or board approved, per biennium. Not required for the first renewal after licensure.
ce.nccpaNote: Active NCCPA certification is accepted as meeting the 30 hour requirement under PA 2.04(3)(a). The rule text accepts it only for sub. (3)(a); the 2 hour controlled substance topic is sub. (3)(b), so the safe reading is that the 2 hours are still owed (the DSPS page wording is ambiguous).

topicMandates.appliesTo: All PA licensees renewing (part of the 30 hours); not the first renewal

ce.controlledSubstanceCe: 2 of the 30 hours each biennium on responsible controlled substances prescribing (PA 2.04(3)(b)).

practice.agreementFilingAndRenewal: PA keeps, and gives the board on request, either (a) evidence of an employment arrangement in which a physician is primarily responsible for the overall direction and management of the PA's professional activities, or (b) a written collaborative agreement with a physician signed by both, describing scope of practice and an alternate collaborating physician protocol. Not filed with the board; no renewal cycle; either party may terminate on 30 days' written notice. If the collaborating physician is unavailable more than 90 business days a new agreement is needed; if none is available, a PA with at least 2,080 hours in the same specialty notifies the board within 3 business days and may continue up to 120 business days (PA 3.04(3)(a)).
practice.notes: Wisconsin is a PA Licensure Compact member (Wis. Stat. 448.988 compact privilege). PAs supervised by a podiatrist follow separate rules.

prescribing.separateAuthorityRegistration: None. Prescribing authority is part of the PA licence (Wis. Stat. 448.975(1)(b)); a federal DEA registration authorizes controlled substance dispensing in Wisconsin (Wis. Stat. 961.32(1m)(a)).
prescribing.ceForPrescribers: 2 hours responsible controlled substances prescribing each biennium (applies to all PA licensees).

board.name: Wisconsin Board of Nursing (administered by DSPS)

rn.renewalDeadline: March 1 of each even numbered year
rn.notes: No continuing education is required for the Wisconsin RN licence; renewal requires the nursing workforce survey.

aprn.title: APRN (Advanced Practice Registered Nurse) with specialty designation Nurse Practitioner (N.P.); replaced the APNP certificate on September 1, 2026 (2025 Wis. Act 17)
aprn.separateLicenceOrCertificate: Separate APRN licence (requires WI RN licence or NLC multistate RN licence). Existing APNPs were converted to APRN licences on September 1, 2026; renewal of the APRN licence also renews a WI RN licence held.
aprn.renewalDeadline: March 1 of each even numbered year (first APRN renewal for converted APNPs coincides with the RN renewal in February 2028)
aprn.ceNote: 16 contact hours per biennium in clinical pharmacology or therapeutics relevant to the area of practice, including at least 2 contact hours in responsible prescribing of controlled substances. No other APRN CE hours.
aprn.otherRenewalItems: Evidence of malpractice liability insurance at every renewal; nursing workforce survey.

topicMandates.appliesTo: All APRNs (within the 16 hours), per the DSPS APRN page; statute 441.09(4) sets the 16 hours for every APRN, including any whose licence carries a no prescribing notation

prescribing.separateAuthorityRegistration: No separate registration after September 1, 2026: prescribing is part of the APRN licence unless the licence carries a 'may not issue prescription orders' notation.
prescribing.pharmacologyCeForPrescribers: 16 contact hours clinical pharmacology or therapeutics per biennium
prescribing.controlledSubstanceCe: 2 contact hours responsible prescribing of controlled substances per biennium (within the 16)

practice.transitionNote: Default is practice in collaboration with a physician or dentist. Independent practice requires board verification on application of: 3,840 hours of professional nursing in a clinical setting, 3,840 clinical hours of APRN practice in the role with a physician or dentist immediately available, and at least 24 months elapsed for each. Approval is shown on the licence. Invasive pain treatment keeps a physician collaboration requirement outside hospital settings.
practice.agreementFilingAndRenewal: Collaborative relationship must be documented by the APRN; it is not filed with DSPS (evidence may be requested in a disciplinary matter). No renewal cycle for the relationship.
